categories.title: Expense categories
categories.intro: Your business starts with 18 categories. Add your own or deactivate the ones you don't use: a deactivated category is no longer offered when recording expenses, but keeps its history.

form.name: Name
form.codeHint: The code is generated from the name and does not change afterwards.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”
delete.body: The category is deleted and cannot be recovered. If it already has expenses on record it cannot be deleted: deactivate it instead.
